title: microwave panic
pitch: the computer is a microwave now. hold to cook, let go when it's done. read the popcorn, the egg, the burrito. never microwave the fork.
controls: hold anywhere (or hold space / enter) to cook, let go when the food is done. popcorn pops slow down, the egg wobbles, the fish stinks. metal: let go at once. m mutes.
